description: This Java class 'JsonExamplesProducer' generates example JSON files for testing or documentation purposes related to connectivity commands and responses in the Eclipse Ditto project. It reads no external source files but references many external classes and methods to build the JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates sample JSON files representing connectivity commands, responses, and exceptions for testing or documentation purposes in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application that triggers JSON file generation based on command line arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates arguments and initiates the production of JSON files into the specified directory.

methods.name: produceConnectivityCommands
methods.description: Coordinates the generation of command and response JSON files, as well as exceptions.

methods.name: produceModifyCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for connectivity modification commands like test, create, modify, delete, open, close.

methods.name: produceModifyResponse
methods.description: Generates JSON files for responses to modification commands.

methods.name: produceViewCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for retrieval commands such as retrieve connection, status, and metrics.

methods.name: produceViewCommandResponse
methods.description: Generates JSON files for the responses to retrieval commands, including connection state, metrics, and statuses.

methods.name: produceExceptions
methods.description: Generates JSON files representing various exception cases during connectivity operations.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to the specified file path.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Begins the JSON generation process for the entire connectivity folder structure.
